# Plain-file notes kept under one directory.
module Notes
  def self.read(root, name)
    path = File.join(root, name)
    return nil unless File.file?(path)
    File.read(path)
  end
end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'notes'

class NotesTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_reads_existing_note
    Dir.mktmpdir do |root|
      File.write(File.join(root, 'todo.txt'), 'milk')
      assert_equal 'milk', Notes.read(root, 'todo.txt')
    end
  end
end
